strings.settings.global_hotkeys.heading: Global hotkeys
strings.settings.global_hotkeys.scope: Manage built-in Simpilot hotkeys and custom hotkeys for applications, folders, or files. Enabled Win+letter hotkeys take priority over the corresponding Windows shortcut; Win+L cannot be overridden.
strings.settings.win_l_unsupported: Win+L is the Windows security lock shortcut and cannot be assigned as a 简驭 | Simpilot global hotkey.
strings.settings.general.scope: Configure startup behavior, pointer location, and the appearance of the quick-launch menu.

strings.about.positioning: A focused quick launcher and global hotkey manager
strings.about.tagline: Bring everyday shortcuts and frequent actions together in one tray icon and a set of global hotkeys.
strings.about.local_data: Core features require no account or cloud service. Settings, cache data, and logs stay in the local application directory; hotkeys and shortcut blocking are removed when Simpilot exits.
strings.about.third_party_summary: Integrates Everything and nlohmann/json; keyboard capture, hotkey handling, and physical-key mapping are independently implemented by Simpilot.
strings.about.open_failed: The selected item could not be opened. Check the default browser or file association.
strings.ui.startup_update_failed: The current user's Windows startup entry could not be updated.
strings.backup.heading: Settings backup and migration
strings.backup.portable: Settings stay beside the program. Update in the same folder to keep them, or import a backup or migrate your old folder.
strings.backup.exported: All saved settings have been exported.
strings.backup.confirm:
Restore {} files and all module settings, replacing your saved configuration. Managed files absent from the backup, including a second menu, will be removed.

Your current settings will first be backed up in Backups, then Simpilot will restart. External applications are not copied.
strings.backup.missing: These application paths or input methods are unavailable here. Their settings will be retained; review them after restoring:
strings.backup.failed: The operation did not finish. Automatic recovery data is retained. Restart Simpilot to finish any pending recovery.
strings.backup.startup_failed: Settings could not be loaded safely. Modules have not started, to protect your configuration. Check the path and permissions below or restore a complete backup. Original files and recovery data in Backups are retained.
strings.backup.restored: All settings have been restored. Your previous configuration is saved in Backups.
strings.backup.rolled_back: An interrupted restore has been recovered. Review your settings; the original backup remains in Backups.
strings.backup.apply_import: Apply changes, then select a backup
strings.backup.discard_import: Continue; discard drafts only if restoring
strings.backup.restart_failed: Automatic restart failed. Start Simpilot again to finish restoring.
strings.backup.cancel_pending: Cancel this unapplied restore and keep the current settings? The selected backup will remain in Backups.
